previous_statement: By 1.7.1 the thresholds have the required universal ranges. For the arbitrary instance fixed in 1.7.2, nodes 1.7.2 and 1.7.3 establish the two group-law guards and the polar-retraction guard. Node 1.7.4 gives the root's explicit C^1 diffeomorphism and unique inverse (u_pol,h_pol); node 1.7.5.1 gives the C^1 formulas, three exact identities, and five estimates with bound A*epsilon_r for u_grp; and node 1.7.7, using lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality, gives u_grp=u_pol on S_delta and hence for every value used by those formulas. Substitution transfers all group conclusions to the root-bound u_pol. Since epsilon_r>=0 and A=C_grp^0<=C_grp, A*epsilon_r<=C_grp*epsilon_r. The instance was arbitrary, so these witnesses prove the root contract.
new_statement: The attempted final transport is withdrawn. Node 1.7.4 supplies one fully typed polar datum D_pol=(delta,S_delta,u_pol,h_pol) for the explicit map Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H, while 1.7.5.1 supplies the group-law conclusions G(u_grp) for the function called u_delta by lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws. The coherence external is conditional on two fully typed bijective polar data; the allowed group-laws external supplies neither a datum D_grp=(delta_grp,S_grp,u_grp,h_grp) nor the weaker pointwise preimage facts from 1.7.5.2. Therefore coherence cannot be instantiated with u_grp, u_grp=u_pol is not established, and substitution is unavailable. The inequality A*epsilon_r<=C_grp*epsilon_r only weakens G(u_grp); it does not turn G(u_grp) into G(u_pol). Hence the present dependencies do not prove the root contract. This records a gap in this proof branch, not a refutation of the root: completion requires either a synchronized allowed result or a direct derivation of the requisite pointwise preimage identities.
